subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose host update execution to gateway-authenticated HTTP callers, and should that be a dedicated `/admin/update` contract or an allowlisted Admin HTTP RPC wrapper around `update.run`?
rationale: The request would turn a privileged host package-update and restart operation into a network-reachable HTTP surface, while current code exposes only `update.status` over Admin HTTP RPC and keeps `update.run` as a control-plane write.

options.title: Split and design first
options.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower tracker and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

options.title: Expose via Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Allow or wrap `update.run` only with explicit private-ingress, auth, audit, rate-limit, failure-mode, and upgrade-proof requirements.

options.title: Reject HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane surfaces and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split and design first
recommendation.body: Keep version metadata in the narrower tracker and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across Admin HTTP RPC, gateway probe/version behavior, and the security-sensitive operator surface.
